text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: ABSTRACTION LEVEL 1 - STRATEGIC PROCESS LANDSCAPE. One activity per business phase and no internal roles: the purpose of this view is to make the system boundary and the external dependencies readable on one page, not to show who does what. Internal

responsibilities, decisions and business rules are shown at level 2 in S2_Strategic_Referral_To_Authorisation (referral intake to treatment authorisation) and S3_Strategic_Treatment_To_Aftercare (funding, payment, delivery, correspondence, enquiries

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: GAPS BETWEEN THIS BUSINESS PROCESS AND THE INITIAL RELEASE. Not implemented: role-based access control and authentication; audit records that ordinary users cannot edit; the management reporting set; a procedure for recording activity completed

during a period of system or external-service unavailability; patient communication preferences, accessible formats and translation support; and a single correlation record that binds patient, referral, treatment request, appointment, funding

decision, payment transaction and refund into one auditable episode. The rules that determine urgency for referrals and enquiries have not been agreed by the hospital, so those decisions are modelled with asserted variables rather than rules.
